US Midterm Elections: Polls Show Democrats With Edge, Trump a Key Motivator

A CBS News Battleground Tracker poll indicates Democrats hold an edge in House seats in the upcoming midterm elections, with former President Donald Trump serving as a significant motivator for both Democratic and Republican voters. Politico reports that Democratic voters are more driven by opposition to Trump than by the party's platform. CNN notes that Democrats plan to intensify investigations into the Trump family, the White House, and Jeffrey Epstein if they secure control of the House.
